sloka: यावच्चन्द्रश्च सूर्यश्च यावत्तिष्ठति मेदिनी ।यावच्च मत्कथा लोके तावद्राज्यं तवास्त्विह ।। ७.१०८.२८ ॥
transliteration: yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca yāvattiṣṭhati medinī ।yāvacca matkathā loke tāvadrājyaṁ tavāstviha ।। 7.108.28 ॥

translations.english: Rama declared that Vibhishana's kingdom would endure as long as the moon and sun exist, as long as the earth remains, and as long as Rama's story is told in the world.
